question: In a certain code language, 'QUART' is written as 'RSBPU' and 'LEMON' is written as 'MCNMO'. How will 'JUMPY' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'QUART' is written as 'RSBPU',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ca7a5460af7ab02c0154cf44a9c0419e0029b189bb75a68fb4e2df98fbcbadb.png] 

‘LEMON' is written as 'MCNMO’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f775f8308f2049c917cb46236bb112618db46683b8dfae6c4ffdb25341f2790.png] 

Similarly, for '**JUMPY**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca1a5e83b4831e32c4041654b6638f5fcb3ac1cecf14f4b37da2eebc7180efda.png] 

So, '**JUMPY**' will be written as '**KSNNZ**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
